title: じゃじゃウマ姫のパーティー

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess and I have been invited to a party held by one of King Halo's acquaintances.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: W-wooow! So… this is what a first-rate party is like! Wh-what a magnificent venue, and such amazing food!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Are you okay, Kawakami? Do you remember what to do first when arriving at a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Eh? Ah, um, of course! Umm… I need to, uh…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh! I need to hoard all the most delicious food before anyone else gets a chance!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No! You're supposed to greet the party organizer! Come on, we prepared for this!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ahhhhh!
choice_data_list: Now, now. No need to be so harsh.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Don't spoil her! I understand that she's nervous, but she's only going to embarrass herself at this rate.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Anyway, Kawakami, pull yourself together and let's go greet the organizer! I'll come with you, so look dignified!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Party Organizer
text_block_list.text: Oh, if it isn't King! How long has it been? It's so good to see you again!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, it has been some time since we last spoke. I'd like to introduce you to my classmate, Kawa—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: A p-pleasure to make your acquaintance, and how do you do?! I am Kawakami Princess! Yes, it is very nice to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Party Organizer
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, it's nice to see someone so enthusiastic!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: R-really?! Oh, I did it! You know, it was King who taught me what to do! "When greeting someone, project your voice loudly and clearly!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: W-well, let's not dwell on that, shall we? Moving on… I heard you did some work with my mother recently, is that right?

text_block_list.name: Party Organizer
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes. She truly is a world-class designer. Her recent work was positively perfect. I have nothing but gratitude.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, no need for that. She's the one who's grateful for all the help you give—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Aaahhh! That just gave me a hilarious idea! Speaking of help, King is always helping me, too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: K-Kawakami?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That is… except the other day when I broke a teacup for the eighteenth time. She got so mad. She was like, "Clean this up at once! And don't ask for help!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Which leads to my knockout princess joke! What would King give me if I were to spill hot tea everywhere?

text_block_list.name: Party Organizer
text_block_list.text: …I don't know. What would she give you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Why, a proper scalding, of course!

text_block_list.name: Party Organizer
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Just what do you think you're doing?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Eeek!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: My goodness, Kawakami! You're lucky our host is a man of great tolerance. If it were anyone else, you might've been kicked out!
choice_data_list: L-look, at least she was giving it her best shot…
Could you teach her proper etiquette?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Shot"? More like her best active grenade!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: P-please don't be mad! I just thought it was a great chance to bust out a witty princess joke!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Oh!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What? Have you realized the folly of what you did?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Um, what does a furious King have in common with the wonderful steak they served at the party?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: They were both steaming! How's that one?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Not funny at all! Come here at once, Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Nooo! Please forgive meee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Kawakami Princess is still a ways away from conducting herself in a manner befitting a princess.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You're right! I'll simply have to drill the fundamentals into her once again!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, but I truly did study in preparation for this party. I learned all about the art of witty conversation…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You would have been better off spending that time studying etiquette.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now, I won't deny that it can be important to slip in a small joke during situations like that…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?! So my judgment was spot on?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No, it was still unacceptable! For instance, why was I the butt of your joke?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: E-eeek!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, Kawakami Princess starts taking joke lessons from King Halo three times a week.
